title: Squadron 42 finally has a Steam page 🚀
subject: squadron42
description:
Will you wishlist Squadron 42? 👇

Star Citizen's single-player campaign Squadron 42 now has a Steam store page with wishlisting open, as of October 10, 2026. Cloud Imperium Games is targeting Q2 2027 on PC, with a cast led by Mark Hamill, Gary Oldman, Gillian Anderson and Henry Cavill.

Sources: Squadron 42 Steam store page, tbreak (Oct 10, 2026), MonsterVine (Oct 10, 2026), IGN / TechSpot on the Q2 2027 delay
Game footage/images © their respective owners.

scenes.text: Squadron 42 finally has a Steam page.
Star Citizen's single-player campaign is now listed on Steam, and you can wishlist it today.
Cloud Imperium is targeting a release between April and June 2027, on PC.
You play a rookie in the UEE Navy in the year 2945, from fighter cockpits to capital ships.
The cast includes Mark Hamill, Gary Oldman, Gillian Anderson and Henry Cavill.
Chris Roberts moved the game out of late 2026 to avoid the launch of GTA 6.
